[[File:8-Track-GTASA-gameplay.jpg|thumb|325px|right|The 8-Track event in GTA San Andreas.]]
'''8-Track''' is a racing side mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] held at the [[Los Santos Forum]] in [[Playa del Seville]]/[[East Beach]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]].

== Description ==
8-Track is similar to the [[Hotring]] event in GTA Vice City. The player is required to compete in a 12-lap, stock-car style endurance race on a #21 [[Hotring Racer#Designs and variants|"hotring" variant of the Hotring Racer]] around a figure-8 circuit against 11 other competitors. Unlike Hotring, however, the durability of the player's and competitors' Hotring Racer is much better (although it is still less so than most road vehicles), and the pitstop is no longer available; the player must also finish first to receive any reward. In addition, players must have a sufficiently high [[Statistics|driving skill]] (at least 20% full) to enter for an 8-Track race.

Completion of 8-Track in first place is required for [[Completion in GTA San Andreas|100% completion in GTA San Andreas]].

== Reward ==
The monetary reward for finishing first in 8-Track is $10,000. In addition, a #21 [[Hotring Racer]] and a "monstera" variant [[Monster Truck|Monster]] will spawn on the northwestern corner of Los Santos Forum's parking lot once 8-Track is completed for the first time.

== Notes ==
* The 8-Track name carries two meanings, either referring to the figure-8 layout of the track, or the [[wp:8-track tape|antiquated form of media]] that predated the cassette tape.
* The track features [[wp:JumboTron|jumbotrons]] that display the race in an overhead angle.
